newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - October 25.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's edition of Daily Variety:
HOLLYWOOD - News Corp Ltd's Fox Entertainment Ltd head John Matoian was hired as president of Time Warner Inc's HBO Pictures and HBO NYC.
NEW YORK - News Corp Ltd is selling at least $1 billion of its BSkyB satcaster securities convertible into BSkyB stock.
WASHINGTON - U.S. Federal Communications Commissioner Susan Ness has set a mid-December deadline to resolve the stalemate over the digital television standard.
